scope: Failure-only test observability; no production timeout, guard or root-cause fix
method: Measure unchanged production calls using monotonic time; attach only scalar elapsed/completed facts to the original factory exception, preserving its type and chain. Native observation is neither replaced nor supplied.
pending: Exact native and hosted execution of the diagnostic fixture
Use a reproduced expiry timing to select and qualify a root-cause repair; do not label the old failure passing
